title: 接地故障断路器的作用与类型
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/11_GFCI - Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter Types of GFCI HSE STUDY GUIDE.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/11_GFCI - Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter Types of GFCI HSE STUDY GUIDE/src.py

points.K7: 接地故障断路器有多种类型
points.K12: 线缆连接型：测试复位键

shots.scene: 欣欣站在车间的工作台旁，台上有一个带按钮的插座，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a workbench in a factory workshop, next to a wall socket with small test buttons, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲接地故障断路器和它的类型。
overlay: 接地故障断路器的作用与类型

shots.scene: 插座、移动插座盒、插头三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a wall socket with buttons, a portable socket box and a plug with buttons. No people.
shots.narration: 它能在关键时刻，替你断电。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在地面潮湿的车间，拿着一把电钻准备插电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands on a damp workshop floor, holding an electric drill and reaching for a socket.
shots.narration: 地面潮湿，阿杰要用电钻打孔。

shots.scene: 电钻外壳漏电、电流经小人图标入地的示意，带警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drill casing leaking current through a person pictogram into the wet floor, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 要是电钻漏电，电会从人身上走。

shots.scene: 老李递给阿杰一个带按钮的便携式接地故障断路器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands the young male student a portable socket box with test and reset buttons.
shots.narration: 老李递来一个便携式接地故障断路器。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着插座盒上的按钮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the buttons on the portable socket box.
shots.narration: 它是怎么保护人的？一起看看。

shots.scene: 电钻外壳经接地线通向大地的示意，线路完好
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a drill's metal casing connected by a ground wire to the earth, intact. No people.
shots.narration: 工具外壳本来有一条通向大地的路。

shots.scene: 接地线中间断开的示意，断口处画红圈
shots.prompt_en: The same diagram with the ground wire broken in the middle, the break circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 这条低电阻的接地路断了，就是接地故障。

shots.scene: 电流箭头从工具外壳经手、身体、脚流入地面
shots.prompt_en: Current arrows flowing from the tool casing through a person pictogram's hand, body and feet into the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 电流就会另找出路，从人身上入地。

shots.scene: 人体图标旁有心跳线和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with a heartbeat line and a red warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 轻则受伤，重则丧命。

shots.scene: 接地故障断路器插座图标上，闪电被一道快速的开关断开
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a protective socket where a lightning bolt is cut off instantly by a fast-opening switch. No people.
shots.narration: 接地故障断路器是快速动作的断路器。

shots.scene: 秒表图标指针只走了一小格
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon whose hand moves only a tiny fraction. No people.
shots.narration: 一出接地故障，1/40秒就断电。

shots.scene: 两根导线穿过一个圆环，流出流回箭头一样长
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two wires passing through a ring sensor with equal current arrows going out and coming back. No people.
shots.narration: 它时刻比较流出和流回的电流。

shots.scene: 回流箭头变短，圆环亮起，开关断开
shots.prompt_en: The return arrow becomes shorter, the ring sensor lights up and the switch opens. No people.
shots.narration: 相差约5毫安，它就立即切断。

shots.scene: 老李用空白检测仪检查插座，并在空白卡上记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a protective socket with a blank tester and notes it on a blank card.
shots.narration: 前提是安装正确、维护到位。

shots.scene: 漏电的电钻插头刚插进去，插座立即跳闸
shots.prompt_en: A leaky drill plug is pushed into the protective socket and the socket trips immediately with its indicator going dark.
shots.narration: 有故障的工具一插上，它就跳闸。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着跳闸的插座，松了口气
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the tripped socket and breathes a sigh of relief.
shots.narration: 跳得够快，事故就来不及发生。

shots.scene: 小人双手同时摸两根带电导线的图标，旁边保护器图标灰掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram touching two live wires at once with both hands, while the protection device icon beside it is greyed out. No people.
shots.narration: 人同时碰到两根带电线，它管不了。

shots.scene: 盾牌挡住经人体入地的电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A shield blocking a current arrow that flows through a person pictogram into the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 它防的是最常见的那种触电。

shots.scene: 火焰、发热、电线外皮烧坏三个图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: A shield in front of three icons: a flame, a heat symbol and a melted wire insulation. No people.
shots.narration: 还能防由此引起的火灾和过热，

shots.scene: 电线外皮完好，旁边盾牌打勾
shots.prompt_en: A wire with intact insulation next to a shield with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 防止导线绝缘被损坏。

shots.section_title: 接地故障断路器有多种类型
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三格白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard divided into three blank boxes.
shots.narration: 接地故障断路器有好几种类型。
overlay: 接地故障断路器有多种类型

shots.scene: 墙上一个带试验、复位按钮的插座
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket with small test and reset buttons built into its face. No people.
shots.narration: 插座型，装在一个或多个插座里。

shots.scene: 一个这样的插座连着旁边几个普通插座
shots.prompt_en: One protective socket wired to protect several ordinary sockets next to it along the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 价格低，用的人越来越多。

shots.scene: 带提手的便携式接地故障断路器插座盒
shots.prompt_en: A portable protective socket box with a carrying handle. No people.
shots.narration: 便携型样式多，都方便携带。

shots.scene: 移动插座盒插在普通墙插上，另一种带长电线
shots.prompt_en: One portable protective box plugged into an ordinary wall socket, and another version with its own long cord and plug. No people.
shots.narration: 可插在普通插座上，或自带电线。

shots.scene: 供电线中间断开，插座盒的指示灯熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The supply cord to the portable box is cut in one wire and the box's indicator light goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 它带失压脱扣，供电线断就断电。

shots.scene: 电动工具的电线末端是一个较大的特殊插头
shots.prompt_en: A power tool cord ending in a larger, special-looking plug with a protection module built in. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆连接型，是内置模块的插头。

shots.scene: 保护范围从插头延伸到整根电线和工具
shots.prompt_en: A highlight spreading from the special plug along the entire cord to the power tool. No people.
shots.narration: 它护住整根电线和连着的工具。

shots.section_title: 线缆连接型：测试复位键
shots.scene: 插头特写，上面有两个空白按钮
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the special plug showing two blank buttons for test and reset. No people.
shots.narration: 插头样子特别，带测试和复位键。
overlay: 线缆连接型：测试复位键

shots.section_title: 线缆连接型：测试复位键
shots.scene: 供电线断开时插头指示灯熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The supply side of the cord is broken and the plug's indicator light goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 它同样带失压脱扣装置。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，板上是电流经人体入地的示意
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard showing a diagram of current flowing through a person pictogram into the ground.
shots.narration: 接地路一断，电就可能走人体。

shots.scene: 圆环比较电流、开关断开的示意
shots.prompt_en: A ring sensor comparing currents and a switch snapping open. No people.
shots.narration: 差约5毫安，1/40秒断开。

shots.scene: 插座式、移动式、插头式三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a protective wall socket, a portable protective box and a protective plug. No people.
shots.narration: 插座型、便携型、线缆连接型。

shots.scene: 两根带电线的图标灰掉，接地故障图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two live wires greyed out, and a ground fault icon blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 不防线间接触，但防最常见的接地故障。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、老李站在工作台旁挥手，台上是便携式接地故障断路器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera together with the young male student and the facility engineer beside a workbench with a portable protective socket box.
shots.narration: 用好接地故障断路器，下次见！
